Priya: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing 'contraction lanes' + signed verdict tokens for safe rollbacks. want to lock down API shape + ownership.

Noah: Sounds good. Two quick constraints: low-latency adjudication and idempotent actions.

Alyssa: For signals I suggest p95 latency, error-rate, and a model-quality delta. normalize each 0..1 and compute weighted composite.

Priya: Prototype composite = 0.5*err + 0.35*latency + 0.15*quality_drop. trigger if >0.7 over 2m window AND short-window spike exists.

Marco: Who executes? central controller OR router-local agent? central = global view, local = resilience. we need hybrid.

Noah: Hybrid: controller issues signed verdict tokens, routers verify signature and apply suggested contraction steps. local agent can issue provisional tokens when controller unreachable.

Alyssa: Token fields: id, tenant, action, confidence, steps, signature, provisional_flag. Keep token compact to minimize wire cost.

Priya: API sketch: POST /v1/verdict { tenant, metrics } -> 200 { token }. Include short payload example in RFC.

Marco: Router rules: verify token, check revocation list, enforce max_delta_per_minute caps, then apply steps with local hysteresis.

Noah: Operational metrics: verdicts_emitted, avg_confidence, token_verification_latency, router_apply_failures. add dashboards + alerts.

Alyssa: Testing: verdict-replay harness in staging that replays sampled traffic and compares router behavior vs simulator. fail if success-rate drop >1%.

Priya: Security: hosted tokens signed with KMS, private installs use local HSM. routers must persist audit record (raw metrics snapshot + token).

Noah: Performance target: adjudicate median <50ms. Use gRPC/protobuf for controller->router for high qps.

Marco: Long-term: separate rules engine from actuation; rules service evaluates signals, controller signs verdicts, routers only act.

Priya: Action items: Noah -> token proto draft (ENG-12001); Alyssa -> replay harness plan (SRE-3002); Marco -> revocation API + caps design (SEC-4400); Priya -> follow-up RFC with example token + API.

Noah: :+1:

Alyssa: :thumbsup:

Marco: Sync tomorrow 11am.
